properties.name: The root-cause skill ships, and the design generates the candidates
properties.rationale:
⭐ ANTHONY CORRECTED THE DESIGN TWICE WHILE IT WAS BEING BUILT, and both corrections are in the shipped skill.

FIRST: the costing had been aimed at the wrong thing. Option (c) of `dec:idea-should-reflow2-serve-a-root-cause-analysis-method` — surfacing a known cause automatically at the moment of a symptom — was measured in detail before he said the point was "not so much can the graph help determine root cause... it is more to direct the agent how to properly do the steps." The target is the AGENT'S PROCESS, which was question 1 on that node's own must-check list, and it had been answered by assumption rather than by asking.

SECOND, AND IT IS THE ONE THAT MADE THE SKILL WORTH SHIPPING: the first draft over-corrected into pure process guidance, with step ③ reading "write down at least three candidate causes". He pushed back — "you can often start fishbone analysis on inspecting the design... there is value in looking at a design (and if it is a software code base... you can inspect the implementation of the design also)". He was right, and the weakness was concrete: an exhortation to think of three produces two real candidates and a filler that exists to satisfy the instruction. Step ③ now walks NINE BONES, each answered by a CALL rather than by memory, and names the artifact layer as the bridge from a symptom to the source files that could have produced it.

🛑 WHY A SKILL AND NOT AN ENFORCED RULE, since the rule already existed. `rule:an-issue-is-root-caused-then-pinned-by-a-test-then-fixed` is Anthony's own and is `enforced: false` by his own decision, for a reason its text states: nothing in a diff or a CI run can see whether a test was FAILING before the fix, so an enforced version could only check something weaker, and a check that reads as enforcement while measuring something else is worse than no check. What a skill changes is DELIVERY, not force — a rule is read once at handshake and states an intention; a skill is pulled at the moment of the work and states an action. The same distinction `req:a-discipline-is-delivered-at-the-tool-not-in-a-catalogue` already draws for conventions.

⚠️ THE SESSION THAT BUILT IT SUPPLIED ITS OWN EXAMPLES, WHICH IS WHY THEY ARE SPECIFIC. Three wrong diagnoses were made and refuted in the course of costing one option: that `search_design` was slow (refuted — `get_node` was equally slow), that every graph call was slow (refuted — this session's own calls plainly were not), and that the cost was per-TCP-connection (refuted — calls 2 and 3 on one connection were just as slow). The actual cause, found only by a discriminating test with a proper MCP handshake, is a ONE-TIME PER-SESSION HYDRATE: 41.11s for the first graph-touching call, then 0.05s and 0.04s. A defect report claiming reflow2 had a severe read-performance problem was one step from being filed, and every step of it felt like understanding.
properties.subject: system
properties.summary: The 22nd served skill. `/root-cause` walks nine steps in order: state the symptom as an observation (not a diagnosis); search for precedent; GENERATE candidates from the design along nine bones; name the measurement that would REFUTE each; take it and check the result rather than that the call finished; ask what CLASS this is; pin it with a test observed failing; fix at the cause and record the cause as a CAUSES edge; and say what could not be established. Shipped with a slash command, mirrored to the .claude and .grok trees, compiled into the binary by build.rs, and pinned by `ver:the-root-cause-skill-forces-rather-than-exhorts`.
